description:
In Episode 224 we discuss the books of Ezra and Nehemiah, and how the prophecies and typologies contained therein are lesson books for our time to show us how we can reconcile it with current events. Prophecy is progressive, but humanity gets fixed in ideas, and then they do not stick to the blueprint and go down a side alley ending in a dead end. If we follow the line of logic and symbolism in the typology, then we can figure out what the events of the last days will be all about.
